name: Mahoshii Swap
detailed_description:
Step into a world where ancient magic and looming darkness collide in Mahoshii Swap a vibrant and challenging 2D platformer with an unique twist.

Born with a rare and powerful magic, Shiina is the only mage capable of confronting the sinister force threatening the world. But she can’t do it alone. Along her journey, she’ll unite with a diverse cast of fellow mages, each wielding distinct abilities that are crucial to overcoming the perils ahead.

Key Features:

  • Switch on the Fly - Seamlessly switch between multiple mages in real-time, each with unique powers that bring classic platforming mechanics to life in fresh, strategic ways.

  • Classic Feel, Modern Twist - Inspired by genre-defining platformers, but with an innovative mechanic that redefines how challenges are tackled.

  • Dynamic Level Design - Levels are crafted around character abilities, encouraging creative problem-solving and rewarding mastery of each mage’s strengths.

  • Challenging, Yet Fair - Designed for fans of tight platforming, offering a satisfying balance of difficulty and discovery.

Join Shiina and her magical allies in an unforgettable adventure full of danger, discovery, and spell-slinging action. Will you master the magic and save the world?

short_description: 2D platformer with retro roots and a unique twist: switch between characters with distinct abilities to conquer challenging levels. Classic in spirit, but with fresh mechanics that reinvent the genre.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 o AMD equivalente
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 o equivalente con soporte para OpenGL 3.3+
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Compatible con DirectX
  • VR Support: No compatible con VR
  • Additional Notes: El juego puede ejecutarse en la mayoría de las laptops modernas y PC de gama baja.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 o superior
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 660 o equivalente
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Tarjeta de sonido compatible con DirectX
  • VR Support: No aplicable
  • Additional Notes: Recomendado mando compatible con XInput para una mejor experiencia.
